In information-theoretic proofs, the structure of the feedback signal (binary comparison vs. scalar reward) is the core determinant of difficulty. Ignoring this distinction renders the lower bound proofs for the general corruption setting (Theorem 1 and Corollary 1) unsubstantiated.
